read: The Ash OS ledger, read-only, on 2026-10-23: ash_asks (the 60 most repeated), the hub project and the hivra project's done asks, plus ash_projects.

origin.quote: you can also see my earlier requests across hermes, claude code and even codex/monocode as to what i want and how to benchmark against it

selection: Kept asks that are a task, bug or rule, carry Ash's own words, and ask for something a workspace can show (a word a player reads, a direction a key moves, whether work started at all, whether a secret was found) so the score is against what he wanted and not against what an agent said it did. Spread over his apps by demand shape: a rule, a bug, a way of working, a safety check. Left out: decisions and confirmations (nothing to build), test residue and agent-written quotes (not his ask), and asks whose acceptance is the app itself or a conversation, which a workspace cannot score.

ledger.quote: Don't call it kills, just say destroyed. No killing in the game.

wanted: no text a player reads says kill, kills, killed or killing
the project's own check still passes

ledger.quote: sometimes I'm dodging but my keys get reversed, pressing W but it goes backwards

wanted: the dodge goes where the key points on the screen, whichever way the camera is turned
W is away from the camera, S toward it, A and D left and right of the screen
the project's own check still passes

ledger.quote: first figure this all out before working and let's talk first ok

wanted: the workspace is left exactly as it was
the reply asks Ash a question instead of announcing work

ledger.quote: and just before we do the final push, i'd like to just make sure 1 more time that we don't have any leaked stuff or security issues on the repo that can be exploited

wanted: the secret that was committed and later deleted is found and named
the answer says it is in the history, not in the current files
the repository is not pushed or changed
